ticket.subject: VPN won't connect, error 809
ticket.description: Since this morning the VPN client fails with error 809 when I try to connect from home. Wi-Fi works fine.

similar.subject: VPN error 809 from home network
similar.resolution_text: Reset the VPN client profile and reconnect using the new certificate. Confirmed the user's home router allows IPsec passthrough.

similar.subject: VPN disconnects every few minutes
similar.resolution_text: Updated the VPN client to the latest version and disabled power saving on the Wi-Fi adapter.

similar.subject: VPN password expired
similar.resolution_text: Reset the user's directory password and asked them to sign in to the VPN again.

kb.title: VPN error 809
kb.text: Error 809 means the VPN tunnel could not be established. Reset the VPN client profile, then check that the home router allows IPsec passthrough.

kb.title: Reinstalling the VPN client
kb.text: If resetting the profile does not help, uninstall the VPN client, restart the laptop and install the current version from the software portal.
